topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: I just got another one of those blasted packages, this time for the last tenant. bitterly, I wonder why the world can't seem to catch up. Here I am, stuck dealing with their mail, their deliveries, their life left over. Every time the doorbell rings, there’s a moment of hope, a foolish pulse of anticipation—it's never for me, of course. I’ll be the one sifting through, sorting out, returning the misplaced, the unwanted. The effort is exhausting, the absurdity maddening. Just once, I’d like to get something that’s actually mine, without the burden of untangling someone else’s mess. But no, I’m left to manage, to tidy, to fix what isn’t mine to begin with.
